questions.prompt: The study of material remains such as tools and pottery is called…
questions.explanation: Archaeologists study the physical remains of the past.
Oral tradition is passed on by word of mouth.

questions.prompt: Comparing several sources that agree makes a historical account more reliable.
Give two strengths and two weaknesses of oral tradition as a source of history.
questions.marking_guide: Strengths (1 each, max 2): available where nothing was written; preserves values/culture; involves the community; cheap. Weaknesses (1 each, max 2): details change in retelling; exaggeration/bias; dates unclear; knowledge lost when elders die.
questions.explanation: Balance strengths (e.g. covers pre-literate times) against weaknesses (e.g. details change in retelling).
